summary: Turn spend analysis into category strategies and measured sourcing value. Explore practical procurement training and enquire about delivery.
lede: Category management and spend analytics help procurement and supply chain professionals turn expenditure data into sourcing decisions and category plans. Learners practise analysing spend, segmenting categories, and comparing sourcing options, then develop an action plan with savings measures. The course also addresses finance validation and stakeholder priorities so sourcing value can be tracked and reviewed.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for procurement and supply chain professionals who analyse expenditure, shape sourcing decisions, or validate the value those decisions create.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of procurement or supply chain processes and familiarity with spreadsheet use are recommended. No coding or programming is required.
